title: Eliminate Maximum Number of Monsters
goal: Eliminate as many approaching monsters as possible before any arrives.
strategy: Sort integer arrival deadlines. The weapon fires at minutes 0,1,2,...; a monster whose deadline is at or before its firing minute has already arrived.
